id-20260813-intro-real-estate-10.title: [Property #10] Why Can One House Have Three Different Valuation Numbers?

segments.src: > Penilai properti tidak menebak harga; mereka menghitungnya lewat tiga jalur — biaya membangun ulang, harga transaksi tetangga, dan pendapatan sewa — lalu menimbang mana yang paling masuk akal untuk properti tersebut.
segments.tr: > Property appraisers don't guess prices; they calculate them through three approaches — reconstruction cost, comparable sales prices, and rental income — then weigh which makes the most sense for that property.
## Today's Concept
Ever heard a story like this?

segments.src: Sebuah rumah dipasang di iklan Rp 1,3 miliar.
segments.tr: A house is listed for Rp 1.3 billion.
The seller is confident the price is fair.

segments.src: Tapi ketika calon pembeli mengajukan KPR, bank mengirim penilai (*appraiser*), dan hasil penilaiannya keluar di angka Rp 1,05 miliar.
segments.tr: But when a potential buyer applies for a mortgage, the bank sends an appraiser, and the appraisal comes in at Rp 1.05 billion.
Who's wrong?

segments.src: Tidak ada yang salah — keduanya menjawab pertanyaan yang berbeda.
segments.tr: Nobody is — they're both answering different questions.
**Asking price** is what the seller wants.

segments.src: **Nilai (value)** adalah estimasi harga yang paling mungkin terjadi di pasar terbuka pada tanggal tertentu, disusun dengan metode yang bisa dipertanggungjawabkan.
segments.tr: **Value** is an estimate of the price most likely to occur in an open market on a given date, derived using a defensible method.

segments.src: Di Indonesia, pekerjaan ini diatur dalam **Standar Penilaian Indonesia (SPI)** dan dilakukan oleh Penilai Publik yang berizin Kementerian Keuangan, biasanya bernaung di bawah KJPP (Kantor Jasa Penilai Publik).
segments.tr: In Indonesia, this work is governed by the **Indonesian Valuation Standards (SPI)** and performed by Public Appraisers licensed by the Ministry of Finance, typically working under a KJPP (Public Appraisal Services Office).
SPI recognizes three main approaches:
Cost Approach**

segments.src: Logikanya: "Berapa biaya membangun properti setara hari ini, lalu dikurangi karena barangnya sudah tidak baru?"
segments.tr: The logic: "What's the cost to build an equivalent property today, then reduce it because it's no longer new?"

segments.src: Nilai = Nilai Tanah + (Biaya Bangun Baru - Penyusutan)
segments.tr: Nilai = Nilai Tanah + (Biaya Bangun Baru - Penyusutan)
Land doesn't depreciate; buildings do.

segments.src: Kalau bangunan berumur 10 tahun dengan umur ekonomis 40 tahun, penyusutan fisik garis lurusnya 25%.
segments.tr: If a building is 10 years old with an economic life of 40 years, straight-line physical depreciation is 25%.

segments.src: (Dalam praktik, penilai juga menghitung keusangan fungsional — misalnya denah yang tidak lagi disukai pasar — dan keusangan ekonomis dari lingkungan sekitar.)
segments.tr: (In practice, appraisers also calculate functional obsolescence — for example, a floor plan no longer favored by the market — and economic obsolescence from the surrounding environment.)

segments.src: Pendekatan ini paling berguna untuk bangunan yang jarang diperjualbelikan: pabrik, gedung sekolah, masjid, gardu listrik.
segments.tr: This approach is most useful for buildings rarely sold on the market: factories, schools, mosques, electrical substations.

segments.src: Kelemahannya, biaya membangun tidak selalu sama dengan nilai pasar.
segments.tr: Its weakness is that construction cost doesn't always equal market value.

segments.src: Membangun kolam renang Rp 300 juta tidak otomatis menaikkan harga rumah sebesar Rp 300 juta.
segments.tr: Building a swimming pool costing Rp 300 million doesn't automatically increase the house price by Rp 300 million.

segments.src: Pendekatan Pasar / Perbandingan Data Pasar (sales comparison approach)**
segments.tr: Market Approach / Sales Comparison Approach**

segments.src: Logikanya: "Rumah sejenis di sekitar sini terjual berapa?"
segments.tr: The logic: "What did similar houses in this area sell for?"

segments.src: Penilai mengambil beberapa data transaksi pembanding, lalu melakukan **penyesuaian** atas perbedaan: luas tanah, lebar jalan di depan, posisi hook atau tusuk sate, kondisi bangunan, status sertifikat (SHM vs HGB), dan waktu transaksi.
segments.tr: The appraiser takes several comparable transaction data and makes **adjustments** for differences: lot size, street frontage width, corner position or layout, building condition, certificate status (SHM vs HGB), and transaction timing.

segments.src: Yang dinilai selalu jadi patokan; pembanding yang "digeser" naik-turun menuju kondisi objek penilaian.
segments.tr: The subject property is always the benchmark; comparables are adjusted up or down to match the subject's condition.

segments.src: Ini pendekatan paling sering dipakai untuk rumah tinggal dan tanah kosong, karena datanya paling banyak.
segments.tr: This is the most commonly used approach for residential properties and vacant land because there's the most data available.

segments.src: Kelemahannya: di Indonesia data transaksi riil sering sulit didapat, dan harga di iklan cenderung lebih tinggi dari harga deal sesungguhnya.
segments.tr: Its weakness: in Indonesia, actual transaction data is often hard to obtain, and listed prices tend to be higher than actual deal prices.
Income Approach**

segments.src: Logikanya: "Kalau properti ini disewakan, berapa arus kas bersihnya, dan berapa harga yang wajar untuk arus kas itu?"
segments.tr: The logic: "If this property is leased, what's its net cash flow, and what's a fair price for that cash flow?"

segments.src: Nilai = Pendapatan Operasional Bersih (NOI) / Tingkat Kapitalisasi
segments.tr: Nilai = Pendapatan Operasional Bersih (NOI) / Tingkat Kapitalisasi

segments.src: NOI adalah pendapatan sewa setahun dikurangi kekosongan (*vacancy*) dan biaya operasional — tapi **belum** dikurangi cicilan KPR dan pajak penghasilan.
segments.tr: NOI is annual rental income less vacancy and operating expenses — but **not yet** less mortgage payments and income taxes.

segments.src: Tingkat kapitalisasi (*cap rate*) bukan angka karangan; ia ditarik dari pasar, yaitu NOI dibagi harga jual properti sebanding yang benar-benar terjadi.
segments.tr: The capitalization rate (*cap rate*) is not made up; it's derived from the market, specifically NOI divided by the actual sale price of comparable properties.

segments.src: Pendekatan ini dipakai untuk aset penghasil pendapatan: ruko, kos-kosan, gudang, gedung perkantoran, hotel.
segments.tr: This approach is used for income-producing assets: commercial units, boarding houses, warehouses, office buildings, hotels.

segments.src: Yang penting: penilai jarang berhenti di satu angka.
segments.tr: What's important: appraisers rarely stop at one number.

segments.src: Ia melakukan **rekonsiliasi** — menimbang hasil dari beberapa pendekatan dan memilih mana yang paling didukung data, bukan sekadar merata-ratakan ketiganya.
segments.tr: They perform **reconciliation** — weighing results from several approaches and choosing which is most supported by data, rather than simply averaging all three.
## In Practice

segments.src: Bu Rani punya rumah dua lantai di kawasan Bekasi: tanah 120 m², bangunan 100 m², umur 10 tahun, sertifikat SHM.
segments.tr: Bu Rani owns a two-story house in Bekasi: land 120 m², building 100 m², 10 years old, with SHM certificate.

segments.src: Ia ingin tahu berapa nilainya sebelum menjual.
segments.tr: She wants to know its value before selling.
Let's work through all three approaches.

segments.src: **Pendekatan Biaya.** Harga tanah di jalan itu sekitar Rp 6 juta/m², jadi nilai tanah Rp 720 juta.
segments.tr: **Cost Approach.** Land in that area goes for about Rp 6 million/m², so land value is Rp 720 million.

segments.src: Biaya membangun rumah setara hari ini sekitar Rp 4,5 juta/m² × 100 m² = Rp 450 juta.
segments.tr: Cost to build an equivalent house today is about Rp 4.5 million/m² × 100 m² = Rp 450 million.
Depreciation at 10/40 years = 25%, or Rp 112.5 million.
Building value becomes Rp 337.5 million.

segments.src: **Pendekatan Pasar.** Rumah di blok sebelah baru terjual Rp 1,15 miliar.
segments.tr: **Market Approach.** A house in the next block just sold for Rp 1.15 billion.

segments.src: Tapi tanahnya 130 m² (lebih luas 10 m²) dan dapurnya sudah direnovasi.
segments.tr: But its lot is 130 m² (10 m² larger) and the kitchen has been renovated.

segments.src: Penilai menyesuaikan: dikurangi Rp 60 juta untuk kelebihan tanah, dikurangi Rp 40 juta untuk renovasi yang tidak dimiliki rumah Bu Rani.
segments.tr: The appraiser adjusts: reduced Rp 60 million for the extra land, reduced Rp 40 million for the renovation Bu Rani's house lacks.

segments.src: **Pendekatan Pendapatan.** Ternyata rumah Bu Rani selama ini disewakan sebagai kos 10 kamar, Rp 1,5 juta per kamar per bulan.
segments.tr: **Income Approach.** It turns out Bu Rani's house has been rented as a boarding house with 10 rooms at Rp 1.5 million per room per month.
Potential annual income is Rp 180 million.

segments.src: Rata-rata satu kamar kosong sepanjang tahun (kekosongan ±10%), jadi pendapatan efektif Rp 162 juta.
segments.tr: On average, one room is vacant year-round (about 10% vacancy), so effective income is Rp 162 million.

segments.src: Listrik area bersama, air, gaji penjaga, dan perawatan menghabiskan Rp 42 juta setahun.
segments.tr: Common area electricity, water, security salary, and maintenance cost Rp 42 million yearly.
NOI = Rp 120 million.

segments.src: Kos-kosan sejenis di daerah itu diperdagangkan pada cap rate sekitar 8%.
segments.tr: Similar boarding houses in that area are traded at a cap rate of about 8%.

segments.src: Tiga angka: Rp 1,06 M — Rp 1,05 M — Rp 1,5 M.
segments.tr: Three numbers: Rp 1.06 B — Rp 1.05 B — Rp 1.5 B.
Not a calculation error, but information.

segments.src: Dua pendekatan pertama memberi tahu Bu Rani nilai rumahnya **sebagai tempat tinggal**.
segments.tr: The first two approaches tell Bu Rani her house's value **as a residence**.

segments.src: Pendekatan ketiga memberi tahu nilainya **sebagai usaha kos yang sudah berjalan**.
segments.tr: The third approach tells its value **as an operating boarding house business**.

segments.src: Selisih Rp 450 juta itu pada dasarnya adalah nilai dari bisnis yang menempel pada properti — dan itu hanya bertahan selama penyewa dan izin usahanya ikut berpindah ke pembeli.
segments.tr: That Rp 450 million difference is essentially the value of the business attached to the property — and it only persists if the tenants and operating permit transfer to the buyer.

segments.src: Catatan penutup yang sering bikin salah paham: **NJOP bukan nilai pasar.** NJOP adalah dasar pengenaan PBB yang ditetapkan pemerintah daerah dan di banyak lokasi berada jauh di bawah harga transaksi.
segments.tr: A closing note that often causes confusion: **NJOP is not market value.** NJOP is the property tax assessment base set by local government and is often far below transaction prices in many locations.

segments.src: Memakai NJOP sebagai patokan jual-beli hampir selalu merugikan penjual.
segments.tr: Using NJOP as a buying-selling benchmark almost always hurts the seller.
## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Pendekatan Biaya menghitung nilai tanah ditambah biaya bangun baru dikurangi penyusutan — cocok untuk bangunan khusus yang jarang diperjualbelikan.
segments.tr: 1. The Cost Approach calculates land value plus new construction cost minus depreciation — suitable for special buildings rarely sold on the market.

segments.src: 2. Pendekatan Pasar membandingkan transaksi properti sejenis lalu menyesuaikan perbedaannya — paling andal untuk rumah tinggal, asalkan data transaksinya tersedia.
segments.tr: 2. The Market Approach compares similar property transactions and adjusts for differences — most reliable for residential properties, provided transaction data is available.

segments.src: 3. Pendekatan Pendapatan mengubah arus kas sewa bersih menjadi nilai lewat tingkat kapitalisasi — dipakai untuk aset penghasil pendapatan, dan hasilnya bisa jauh berbeda dari dua pendekatan lain.
segments.tr: 3. The Income Approach converts net rental cash flow into value through the capitalization rate — used for income-producing assets, and results can differ significantly from the other two approaches.
## ✅ Self-Quiz

segments.src: **1.** Sebuah gedung sekolah swasta hendak dinilai untuk keperluan asuransi.
segments.tr: **1.** A private school building needs to be appraised for insurance purposes.

segments.src: Data transaksi gedung sekolah di kota itu praktis tidak ada, dan gedungnya tidak disewakan.
segments.tr: School building transaction data in that city is practically nonexistent, and the building isn't rented out.
Which approach is most appropriate?
- A. Market Approach
- B. Income Approach
- C. Cost Approach
- D. NJOP Approach

segments.src: **2.** Sebuah ruko menghasilkan NOI Rp 200 juta per tahun.
segments.tr: **2.** A commercial unit produces NOI of Rp 200 million per year.

segments.src: Ruko sebanding di kawasan itu diperdagangkan pada tingkat kapitalisasi 10%.
segments.tr: Similar commercial units in that area trade at a 10% capitalization rate.
What's the indicated value?
- A. Rp 200 million
- B. Rp 1 billion
- C. Rp 2 billion
- D. Rp 20 billion

segments.src: **3.** (O/X) Dalam menghitung NOI, cicilan KPR atas properti tersebut harus dikurangkan dari pendapatan sewa.
segments.tr: **3.** (T/F) When calculating NOI, mortgage payments on the property must be deducted from rental income.
## 📚 Today's Terms

segments.src: - **Penyusutan (depresiasi)** — Berkurangnya nilai bangunan akibat umur fisik, keusangan fungsional, atau faktor ekonomi lingkungan; tanah tidak mengalami penyusutan.
segments.tr: - **Depreciation** — The decrease in building value due to physical age, functional obsolescence, or environmental economic factors; land does not depreciate.

segments.src: - **Penyesuaian (adjustment)** — Koreksi naik atau turun atas harga properti pembanding agar setara dengan kondisi properti yang dinilai.
segments.tr: - **Adjustment** — An upward or downward correction to a comparable property's price to match the appraised property's condition.

segments.src: - **NOI (Pendapatan Operasional Bersih)** — Pendapatan sewa efektif setahun dikurangi biaya operasional, sebelum cicilan utang dan pajak penghasilan.
segments.tr: - **NOI (Net Operating Income)** — Effective annual rental income less operating expenses, before debt service and income taxes.

segments.src: - **Tingkat Kapitalisasi (cap rate)** — Rasio NOI terhadap harga properti sebanding di pasar; makin tinggi cap rate, makin rendah nilai untuk NOI yang sama.
segments.tr: - **Capitalization Rate (cap rate)** — The ratio of NOI to comparable property prices in the market; higher cap rate means lower value for the same NOI.

segments.src: - **KJPP** — Kantor Jasa Penilai Publik, badan usaha tempat Penilai Publik berizin Kementerian Keuangan menjalankan praktik penilaian sesuai SPI.
segments.tr: - **KJPP** — Public Appraisal Services Office, a business entity where Public Appraisers licensed by the Ministry of Finance practice valuation according to SPI.

segments.src: *Jawaban: 1) C — properti khusus tanpa data transaksi dan tanpa pendapatan sewa paling tepat dinilai dari biaya membangun kembali dikurangi penyusutan.
segments.tr: *Answers: 1) C — special properties with no transaction data and no rental income are best valued using reconstruction cost less depreciation.
2) C — Rp 200 million ÷ 0.10 = Rp 2 billion.

segments.src: 3) X — NOI mengukur kinerja properti itu sendiri, terlepas dari cara pembeliannya dibiayai; cicilan KPR adalah biaya pendanaan, bukan biaya operasional.
segments.tr: 3) F — NOI measures the property's performance itself, regardless of how its purchase was financed; mortgage payments are financing costs, not operating costs.

segments.src: Kalau cicilan ikut dikurangkan, dua properti identik akan bernilai berbeda hanya karena pemiliknya berutang atau tidak.*
segments.tr: If mortgage payments were deducted, two identical properties would have different values just because one owner has debt and the other doesn't.*

id-20260813-news-1.title: Government Debt Reaches Rp10.293 Trillion, Ratio to GDP Hits Record 41.26 Percent

segments.src: Kementerian Keuangan merilis data terbaru posisi utang pemerintah pusat per akhir Juni 2026.
segments.tr: The Ministry of Finance released the latest data on the central government's debt position as of the end of June 2026.

segments.src: Total utang tercatat mencapai Rp10.293 triliun, dengan rasio utang terhadap Produk Domestik Bruto (PDB) berada di level 41,26 persen.
segments.tr: The total debt recorded reached Rp10.293 trillion, with the debt-to-GDP ratio standing at 41.26 percent.

segments.src: Angka ini disebut sebagai rasio tertinggi yang pernah tercatat sepanjang sejarah pengelolaan utang negara, meski masih berada di bawah batas maksimal 60 persen yang diatur dalam Undang-Undang Nomor 17 Tahun 2003 tentang Keuangan Negara.
segments.tr: This figure is cited as the highest ratio ever recorded throughout the history of national debt management, although it is still below the maximum limit of 60 percent stipulated in Law No. 17 of 2003 concerning State Finance.
## Details of Debt Position

segments.src: Berdasarkan keterangan resmi yang disampaikan otoritas fiskal, komposisi utang pemerintah masih didominasi oleh instrumen Surat Berharga Negara (SBN), baik yang diterbitkan di pasar domestik maupun valuta asing, ditambah pinjaman bilateral dan multilateral.
segments.tr: Based on the official statement delivered by the fiscal authority, the composition of government debt is still dominated by State Securities (SBN), both issued in the domestic market and in foreign currencies, in addition to bilateral and multilateral loans.

segments.src: Struktur ini secara umum dinilai relatif stabil karena porsi utang dalam mata uang rupiah tetap menjadi mayoritas, sehingga eksposur terhadap fluktuasi nilai tukar dapat lebih terkendali dibandingkan skema pembiayaan yang bergantung penuh pada instrumen valuta asing.
segments.tr: This structure is generally considered relatively stable because the portion of debt in rupiah remains the majority, so exposure to exchange rate fluctuations can be more controlled compared to financing schemes that fully depend on foreign currency instruments.
## Why the Debt Ratio Rises

segments.src: Kenaikan rasio utang terhadap PDB umumnya dipengaruhi oleh kombinasi beberapa faktor, di antaranya kebutuhan pembiayaan defisit anggaran, dinamika nilai tukar rupiah, serta pertumbuhan ekonomi nominal yang menjadi basis perhitungan PDB.
segments.tr: The increase in the debt-to-GDP ratio is generally influenced by a combination of several factors, including the need for financing budget deficits, the dynamics of the rupiah exchange rate, and nominal economic growth which serves as the basis for calculating GDP.

segments.src: Ketika defisit anggaran melebar untuk membiayai belanja prioritas seperti infrastruktur, subsidi, dan program perlindungan sosial, kebutuhan penerbitan utang baru pun cenderung meningkat.
segments.tr: When the budget deficit widens to finance priority expenditures such as infrastructure, subsidies, and social protection programs, the need for new debt issuance tends to increase.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, jika laju pertumbuhan PDB tidak sebanding dengan pertambahan nominal utang, rasio terhadap PDB akan ikut terkerek naik meski secara nominal manajemen utang tetap berjalan sesuai rencana.
segments.tr: On the other hand, if the GDP growth rate is not commensurate with the increase in nominal debt, the ratio to GDP will also be pulled up even though the debt management remains in line with the plan.

segments.src: ## Masih di Bawah Batas Aman, tapi Perlu Diwaspadai
segments.tr: ## Still Below the Safe Limit, but Needs to be Watched

segments.src: Payung hukum domestik menetapkan batas rasio utang terhadap PDB maksimal 60 persen, sehingga posisi 41,26 persen secara teknis masih berada dalam koridor yang diperbolehkan undang-undang.
segments.tr: Domestic law sets a maximum debt-to-GDP ratio limit of 60 percent, so the 41.26 percent position is technically still within the allowed corridor by law.

segments.src: Sejumlah lembaga pemeringkat dan analis ekonomi kerap membandingkan rasio ini dengan negara-negara berkembang lain di kawasan, yang rata-rata juga mengalami kenaikan beban utang pascapandemi dan di tengah tekanan suku bunga global yang masih tinggi.
segments.tr: Several rating agencies and economic analysts often compare this ratio with other developing countries in the region, which on average also experience an increase in debt burden post-pandemic and amidst high global interest rates.

segments.src: Meski demikian, tren kenaikan yang konsisten dari tahun ke tahun biasanya mendorong otoritas fiskal untuk memperketat disiplin anggaran, termasuk mengevaluasi efisiensi belanja negara dan memperluas basis penerimaan pajak, agar ruang fiskal tetap terjaga untuk kebutuhan pembangunan jangka panjang tanpa membebani generasi mendatang secara berlebihan.
segments.tr: However, a consistent increase trend from year to year usually prompts fiscal authorities to tighten budget discipline, including evaluating the efficiency of state expenditures and broadening the tax revenue base, so that fiscal space remains maintained for long-term development needs without overburdening future generations.
## How the Government Manages Risk

segments.src: Kementerian Keuangan menyampaikan bahwa pengelolaan utang tetap mengedepankan prinsip kehati-hatian, antara lain melalui diversifikasi instrumen pembiayaan, pengaturan jatuh tempo utang agar tidak menumpuk pada satu periode tertentu, dan pemantauan rasio bunga utang terhadap penerimaan negara.
segments.tr: The Ministry of Finance stated that debt management still prioritizes the principle of caution, among others through diversification of financing instruments, arrangement of debt maturities so as not to accumulate in a certain period, and monitoring of the interest rate of debt to state revenues.

segments.src: Strategi ini bertujuan menjaga kesinambungan fiskal sekaligus mempertahankan kepercayaan investor domestik maupun asing terhadap surat utang negara.
segments.tr: This strategy aims to maintain fiscal sustainability while maintaining the trust of domestic and foreign investors in state bonds.
## What It Means for the Community

segments.src: Bagi masyarakat umum, rasio utang terhadap PDB merupakan salah satu indikator kesehatan fiskal, namun bukan satu-satunya tolok ukur.
segments.tr: For the general public, the debt-to-GDP ratio is one indicator of fiscal health, but not the only measure.

segments.src: Faktor lain seperti struktur jatuh tempo utang, komposisi mata uang, tingkat suku bunga rata-rata, serta kapasitas penerimaan negara sama pentingnya untuk dinilai secara utuh.
segments.tr: Other factors such as the structure of debt maturities, currency composition, average interest rate, and state revenue capacity are equally important to be evaluated as a whole.

segments.src: Publik disarankan mengikuti rilis data resmi dari Kementerian Keuangan dan Bank Indonesia secara berkala untuk mendapatkan gambaran terkini yang lebih komprehensif, mengingat angka-angka fiskal berpotensi berubah seiring perkembangan kondisi ekonomi domestik dan global.
segments.tr: The public is advised to follow official data releases from the Ministry of Finance and Bank Indonesia on a regular basis to get a more comprehensive and up-to-date picture, considering that fiscal figures have the potential to change along with developments in domestic and global economic conditions.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun untuk tujuan informasi umum berdasarkan data resmi yang dipublikasikan otoritas terkait dan bukan merupakan rekomendasi atau nasihat investasi.*
segments.tr: *This article is compiled for general information purposes based on official data published by relevant authorities and is not a recommendation or investment advice.*

id-20260813-news-2.title: Customs Bribery Scandal Expands: KPK Names New Suspect, Tens of Billions of Rupiah in Funds Suspected to Have Flowed

segments.src: Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi (KPK) kembali memperluas penyidikan kasus dugaan suap di lingkungan Direktorat Jenderal Bea dan Cukai.
segments.tr: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) has once again expanded its investigation into the alleged bribery case within the Directorate General of Customs and Excise.

segments.src: Dalam perkembangan terbaru, lembaga antirasuah ini menetapkan tersangka baru yang dikenal dengan inisial atau nama panggilan "Dedi Congor", menyusul pengembangan penyidikan yang sebelumnya telah menjerat sejumlah pihak lain.
segments.tr: In the latest development, the anti-graft agency has named a new suspect, known by the initials or nickname "Dedi Congor", following the development of an investigation that had previously ensnared several other parties.

segments.src: Penetapan tersangka baru ini menjadi indikasi bahwa dugaan praktik rasuah di sektor kepabeanan berlangsung tidak dalam skala kecil, melainkan melibatkan jaringan yang lebih luas antara oknum pejabat dan pelaku usaha di sektor logistik dan kargo.
segments.tr: The naming of this new suspect indicates that the alleged corrupt practices in the customs sector did not occur on a small scale, but rather involved a wider network between rogue officials and business actors in the logistics and cargo sector.
## Chronology of Case Development

segments.src: Menurut keterangan yang disampaikan pihak KPK, penetapan tersangka baru ini merupakan hasil pengembangan dari penyidikan kasus dugaan suap yang telah berjalan sebelumnya.
segments.tr: According to information provided by the KPK, the naming of this new suspect is the result of the development of the ongoing investigation into the alleged bribery case.

segments.src: Penyidik disebut menemukan alat bukti tambahan yang mengarah pada keterlibatan pihak-pihak lain dalam pusaran dugaan gratifikasi terkait proses pelayanan kepabeanan.
segments.tr: Investigators are said to have found additional evidence pointing to the involvement of other parties in the vortex of alleged gratification related to the customs service process.

segments.src: KPK menegaskan bahwa proses hukum terhadap tersangka baru ini akan berjalan sesuai dengan prosedur yang berlaku, termasuk pemberian hak-hak tersangka untuk membela diri melalui mekanisme praperadilan maupun proses persidangan di Pengadilan Tindak Pidana Korupsi.
segments.tr: The KPK emphasized that the legal process against this new suspect will proceed in accordance with applicable procedures, including granting the suspect's rights to defend themselves through pretrial mechanisms as well as the trial process at the Corruption Court.

segments.src: ## Dugaan Aliran Dana ke Oknum Pejabat
segments.tr: ## Alleged Flow of Funds to Rogue Officials

segments.src: Salah satu poin yang menjadi sorotan dalam pengembangan kasus ini adalah dugaan aliran dana dari sebuah perusahaan kargo kepada oknum pejabat Bea dan Cukai, dengan nilai akumulatif yang disebut-sebut mencapai puluhan miliar rupiah.
segments.tr: One of the points in the spotlight in the development of this case is the alleged flow of funds from a cargo company to rogue Customs and Excise officials, with an cumulative value rumored to reach tens of billions of rupiah.

segments.src: Tim penyidik KPK dikabarkan tengah menelusuri jejak transaksi keuangan tersebut, termasuk kemungkinan penggunaan rekening pihak ketiga maupun modus transfer bertahap untuk mengaburkan asal-usul dana.
segments.tr: The KPK investigation team is reportedly tracing the trail of these financial transactions, including the possible use of third-party accounts and gradual transfer methods to obscure the origin of the funds.

segments.src: Sejauh ini, KPK belum merinci secara menyeluruh identitas seluruh pihak yang terlibat maupun rincian pasti penggunaan dana yang diduga mengalir tersebut.
segments.tr: So far, the KPK has not fully detailed the identities of all parties involved or the exact details of the use of the funds suspected to have flowed.

segments.src: Penyidik disebut masih mendalami peran setiap pihak, termasuk kemungkinan adanya keterlibatan pejabat di tingkat yang lebih tinggi dalam pengambilan kebijakan pelayanan kepabeanan.
segments.tr: Investigators are said to still be deepening the role of each party, including the possibility of involvement of higher-level officials in customs service policy-making.
## Response and Next Steps

segments.src: KPK mengimbau masyarakat maupun pelaku usaha yang memiliki informasi terkait dugaan praktik suap di sektor kepabeanan untuk turut berpartisipasi melalui saluran pengaduan resmi lembaga tersebut.
segments.tr: The KPK urges the public and business actors who have information regarding alleged bribery practices in the customs sector to participate through the agency's official complaint channels.

segments.src: Langkah ini dinilai penting untuk mendukung upaya pemberantasan korupsi di sektor pelayanan publik yang bersinggungan langsung dengan aktivitas perdagangan dan logistik nasional.
segments.tr: This step is considered important to support corruption eradication efforts in the public service sector, which directly intersects with national trade and logistics activities.

segments.src: Kasus ini turut menjadi perhatian publik mengingat sektor kepabeanan memiliki peran strategis dalam arus barang ekspor-impor.
segments.tr: This case has also drawn public attention given that the customs sector plays a strategic role in the flow of export-import goods.

segments.src: Praktik dugaan suap di sektor ini dikhawatirkan dapat berdampak pada iklim usaha, termasuk potensi kerugian negara dari sisi penerimaan pajak dan bea masuk apabila proses pengawasan tidak berjalan sebagaimana mestinya.
segments.tr: It is feared that alleged bribery practices in this sector could impact the business climate, including potential state losses in terms of tax revenue and import duties if the supervision process does not run as it should.
## Important Note

segments.src: Perlu digarisbawahi bahwa status tersangka merupakan bagian dari proses hukum yang masih berjalan.
segments.tr: It should be underlined that the suspect status is part of an ongoing legal process.

segments.src: Sesuai dengan asas praduga tak bersalah, pihak yang berstatus tersangka berhak atas pembelaan hukum dan keputusan akhir mengenai bersalah atau tidaknya seseorang hanya dapat ditentukan melalui putusan pengadilan yang berkekuatan hukum tetap.
segments.tr: In accordance with the presumption of innocence, the party with suspect status is entitled to a legal defense, and the final decision regarding someone's guilt or innocence can only be determined through a court ruling with permanent legal force.

segments.src: Publik diimbau untuk mengikuti perkembangan kasus ini melalui keterangan resmi KPK guna memperoleh informasi yang akurat dan bertanggung jawab.
segments.tr: The public is urged to follow the development of this case through official statements from the KPK to obtain accurate and responsible information.

id-20260813-news-3.title: KPK Probes PKH Rice Social Assistance Contract, Chief Commissioner of Distributor Company Examined Over Alleged State Loss

segments.src: Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi (KPK) kembali bergerak mengusut dugaan penyimpangan dalam penyaluran bantuan sosial (bansos) beras Program Keluarga Harapan (PKH).
segments.tr: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) is once again moving to investigate alleged irregularities in the distribution of rice social assistance under the Family Hope Program (PKH).

segments.src: Dalam perkembangan terbaru, tim penyidik memeriksa Komisaris Utama sebuah perusahaan penyalur, Dosni Roha, untuk mendalami kewajaran nilai kontrak pengadaan dan distribusi beras bansos tersebut.
segments.tr: In the latest development, the investigative team is examining the Chief Commissioner of a distribution company, Dosni Roha, to scrutinize the fairness of the procurement contract value and distribution of the rice social assistance.

segments.src: ## Fokus Pemeriksaan pada Kewajaran Nilai Kontrak
segments.tr: ## Focus of Examination on Contract Value Fairness

segments.src: Menurut keterangan yang disampaikan pihak KPK, pemeriksaan terhadap saksi dilakukan untuk mengonfirmasi proses penyusunan kontrak, mekanisme penentuan harga, hingga alur pembayaran dalam proyek penyaluran bansos beras PKH.
segments.tr: According to statements provided by the KPK, the examination of witnesses is conducted to confirm the contract drafting process, price determination mechanisms, and payment flow in the PKH rice social assistance distribution project.

segments.src: KPK menggandeng Badan Pengawasan Keuangan dan Pembangunan (BPKP) untuk melakukan audit dan penghitungan independen atas kewajaran nilai kontrak dimaksud.
segments.tr: KPK has partnered with the Financial and Development Supervision Agency (BPKP) to conduct an independent audit and calculation of the fairness of the said contract value.

segments.src: "Pemeriksaan ini bagian dari upaya penyidik melengkapi alat bukti terkait dugaan penyimpangan dalam pelaksanaan kontrak penyaluran bansos beras," demikian disampaikan pihak KPK saat dikonfirmasi awak media.
segments.tr: "This examination is part of the investigators' effort to supplement evidence related to alleged irregularities in the implementation of the rice social assistance distribution contract," KPK said when confirmed by the media crew.

segments.src: Kolaborasi antara KPK dan BPKP dinilai penting mengingat kompleksitas rantai pasok bansos beras, mulai dari pengadaan di tingkat produsen atau distributor, proses logistik, hingga penyaluran akhir kepada penerima manfaat PKH.
segments.tr: Collaboration between KPK and BPKP is considered important given the complexity of the rice social assistance supply chain, from procurement at the producer or distributor level, logistics processes, to the final distribution to PKH beneficiaries.

segments.src: Audit kewajaran harga menjadi salah satu instrumen kunci untuk memastikan apakah nilai kontrak yang disepakati sesuai dengan harga pasar wajar atau justru terindikasi digelembungkan (mark up).
segments.tr: Price fairness audit becomes a key instrument to ensure whether the agreed contract value aligns with a reasonable market price or is indicated to be inflated (mark up).

segments.src: ## Dugaan Kerugian Negara Ratusan Miliar Rupiah
segments.tr: ## Alleged State Loss of Hundreds of Billion Rupiah

segments.src: Berdasarkan hasil penyelidikan awal, KPK menyebut adanya indikasi potensi kerugian keuangan negara yang nilainya diperkirakan mencapai ratusan miliar rupiah.
segments.tr: Based on initial investigation results, KPK mentioned indications of potential state financial loss estimated to reach hundreds of billions of rupiah.

segments.src: Meski demikian, angka pasti kerugian negara masih menunggu hasil audit investigatif resmi dari BPKP yang hingga kini masih berjalan.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, the exact amount of state loss is still awaiting the official investigative audit results from BPKP, which is still ongoing.

segments.src: KPK menegaskan bahwa proses hukum masih berada pada tahap pengumpulan alat bukti dan pendalaman fakta, sehingga status hukum semua pihak yang diperiksa, termasuk Dosni Roha, saat ini masih sebagai saksi.
segments.tr: KPK emphasizes that the legal process is still at the stage of gathering evidence and deepening facts, so the legal status of all examined parties, including Dosni Roha, remains as witnesses for now.

segments.src: Lembaga antirasuah itu juga mengingatkan agar publik menghormati asas praduga tak bersalah selama proses penyidikan berlangsung, mengingat penetapan tersangka baru dapat dilakukan setelah alat bukti dinyatakan cukup sesuai ketentuan hukum acara pidana yang berlaku.
segments.tr: The anti-corruption agency also reminds the public to respect the presumption of innocence during the investigation, noting that suspect designation can only be made after evidence is deemed sufficient under the applicable criminal procedural law.

segments.src: ## Program PKH dan Pentingnya Pengawasan Bansos
segments.tr: ## PKH Program and the Importance of Social Assistance Oversight

segments.src: Program Keluarga Harapan merupakan salah satu program bantuan sosial andalan pemerintah yang menyasar keluarga miskin dan rentan di seluruh Indonesia.
segments.tr: The Family Hope Program is one of the government's flagship social assistance programs targeting poor and vulnerable families across Indonesia.

segments.src: Penyaluran bansos beras dalam skema ini melibatkan banyak pihak, mulai dari kementerian terkait, badan usaha penyalur, hingga jaringan distribusi di daerah, sehingga potensi risiko penyimpangan turut membesar seiring skala anggaran yang digelontorkan negara.
segments.tr: Rice social assistance distribution in this scheme involves many parties, from relevant ministries, distribution enterprises, to regional distribution networks, thereby increasing the potential risk of irregularities as the budget scale disbursed by the state grows.

segments.src: Sejumlah pegiat antikorupsi menilai kasus ini menjadi pengingat pentingnya transparansi dan akuntabilitas dalam setiap tahap pengadaan barang dan jasa yang dibiayai anggaran negara, khususnya program yang menyentuh langsung kelompok masyarakat rentan.
segments.tr: Several anti-corruption activists view this case as a reminder of the importance of transparency and accountability at every stage of procurement of goods and services funded by the state budget, especially programs that directly affect vulnerable community groups.

segments.src: Pengawasan yang ketat diharapkan dapat mencegah kebocoran anggaran yang seharusnya digunakan untuk kesejahteraan penerima manfaat.
segments.tr: Strict oversight is expected to prevent budget leakage that should be used for the welfare of beneficiaries.
## Ongoing Legal Process

segments.src: KPK memastikan akan terus mendalami keterangan para saksi lain yang terkait dengan proyek ini guna menyusun konstruksi perkara secara utuh.
segments.tr: KPK assures it will continue to delve into the statements of other witnesses related to this project to construct a comprehensive case narrative.

segments.src: Publik diimbau untuk mengikuti perkembangan kasus ini melalui saluran informasi resmi KPK agar memperoleh informasi yang akurat dan berimbang.
segments.tr: The public is urged to follow the case developments through KPK's official information channels to obtain accurate and balanced information.

segments.src: Hingga berita ini diturunkan, belum ada pernyataan resmi tambahan dari pihak Dosni Roha maupun manajemen perusahaan terkait mengenai substansi pemeriksaan tersebut.
segments.tr: As of this report's release, there has been no additional official statement from Dosni Roha or the company's management regarding the substance of the examination.

segments.src: KPK menyatakan pihaknya tetap membuka ruang klarifikasi bagi semua pihak yang diperiksa sesuai prosedur hukum yang berlaku.
segments.tr: KPK states that it remains open to providing clarification for all examined parties in accordance with applicable legal procedures.
